_comment: 12 reference monsters establishing the monster schema. loot_table chance is 0..1; currency drops use is_currency+currency_id.

chicken.name: Scrub Fowl
chicken.flavour: Half-wild fowl that survived the ashfall by being too aggressive to catch.

cow.name: Longhorn Steer
cow.flavour: Frontier cattle, patient and enormous. The horns are not decorative.

golbin.name: Cinderkin Raider
golbin.flavour: Ash-touched scavengers. Quick, poorly armoured, and they never raid alone.

zombie_hand.name: Graveclaw
zombie_hand.flavour: A hand that kept working after the rest of it stopped.

skeleton.name: Barrowbones
skeleton.flavour: Cairn debris, walking. The barrows resent being opened.

spider.name: Fen Spinner
spider.flavour: Reed-height and patient. The web is the warning.

bandit.name: Sable Rook
bandit.flavour: Road-thieves in dyed leather. They know the viaduct better than you do.

moss_giant.name: Mossbound Colossus
moss_giant.flavour: Old stone that grew a coat and decided to stand up.

guard.name: Sunderhold Sentry
guard.flavour: Still on duty. The orders are older than the settlement.

rune_knight.name: Glyphbound Knight
rune_knight.flavour: Armour written over with binding script. The script is winning.

green_dragon.name: Verdant Wyrm
green_dragon.flavour: Slept through the ashfall under the moss. Waking up irritable.

golbin_chief.name: Cinderkin Warchief
golbin_chief.flavour: Leads the Warrens. Wears the settlement's missing anvil as a shield.

air_god.name: Warden of Gales, Sylphine
air_god.flavour: Keeper of the summit instruments. She has been waiting for a student, not a challenger.

water_elemental.name: Tide Wisp
water_elemental.flavour: Water that has been told what to do.

water_god.name: Warden of Tides, Marrowen
water_god.flavour: Keeps the reliquary's ledger. Everyone's name is in it.

earth_god.name: Warden of Stone, Delvhar
earth_god.flavour: He cut the mine that broke the ridge, and he will not explain why.

fire_elemental.name: Ember Wisp
fire_elemental.flavour: A coal that learned to move.

fire_god.name: Warden of Embers, Pyrra
fire_god.flavour: Tends the kiln. Believes the ashfall was the correct price.

mist_wraith.name: Murk Wraith
mist_wraith.flavour: Ash and drowned breath, holding a shape out of habit.

the_mist.name: The Murk Incarnate
the_mist.flavour: The ashfall given a voice. It repeats what you said, later.

dark_herald.name: Herald of the Long Dusk
dark_herald.flavour: Announces the dark the way weather announces rain.

drowned_sailor.name: Barnacled Deckhand
drowned_sailor.flavour: Kept working the drowned road. Still on shift.

underwater_king.name: Tidewrack King
underwater_king.flavour: Rules Nhalassar's upper terraces and resents the surface.

abyssal_imp.name: Umbral Imp
abyssal_imp.flavour: Small, fast, and delighted to be here.

abyssal_fiend.name: Umbral Fiend
abyssal_fiend.flavour: The Deep's outrider. Built out of what it has eaten.

abyssal_lord.name: Umbral Lord
abyssal_lord.flavour: Commands the Deep's attention, which is a job nobody wants.

the_herald.name: The Herald Ascendant
the_herald.flavour: The ashfall wearing a crown. It has been waiting at the Seat for you.

cinderkin_scout.name: Cinderkin Scout
cinderkin_scout.flavour: Ash tunnel scouts mark trespassers for the raiders behind them.

barrow_wraith.name: Barrow Wraith
barrow_wraith.flavour: A forgotten name wrapped in burial cloth and cold blue fire.

drowned_wayfarer.name: Drowned Wayfarer
drowned_wayfarer.flavour: The old coastal road still leads its travelers out of the surf.

rook_marksman.name: Rook Marksman
rook_marksman.flavour: Rook archers watch the viaduct from the ruins above.

frostfang_wolf.name: Frostfang Wolf
frostfang_wolf.flavour: Ice gathers on its fangs before the pack even comes into view.

ash_drake.name: Ash Drake
ash_drake.flavour: Young ashwyrms stalk the lava vents below the greater wyrm.

broodweb_hunter.name: Broodweb Hunter
broodweb_hunter.flavour: A long-legged ambusher that waits where the web meets the reeds.

rift_weaver.name: Rift Weaver
rift_weaver.flavour: It knots broken space into snares around Riftmouth.

greyharrow_husk.name: Greyharrow Husk
greyharrow_husk.flavour: A man-shaped absence in the dust. It stands where the cut was deepest.

shale_stalker.name: Shale Stalker
shale_stalker.flavour: Flat as a fallen slab until it isn't. The shard-spray comes first, the bite after.

quarry_echo.name: Quarry Echo
quarry_echo.flavour: Whatever was shouted here last still hasn't finished. It always finds you.

slag_golem.name: Slag Golem
slag_golem.flavour: Kiln-waste and old mortar, knitted into something with a temper.

brine_troll.name: Brine Troll
brine_troll.flavour: It has been sitting in the same pool so long the salt grew over its back.

tidewrack_hag.name: Tidewrack Hag
tidewrack_hag.flavour: She sings the tide back in. The tide has not come back. She keeps singing.

sunderhold_centurion.name: Sunderhold Centurion
sunderhold_centurion.flavour: Outranks the sentries still standing their posts. Has not noticed they are dead.

ashwyrm_seer.name: Ashwyrm Seer
ashwyrm_seer.flavour: Reads the caldera the way a sailor reads weather, and has never once been wrong.

sunderhold_ballistarius.name: Sunderhold Ballistarius
sunderhold_ballistarius.flavour: Sights the breach from the wall and never wastes a bolt on anything closer.

tidebound_revenant.name: Tidebound Revenant
tidebound_revenant.flavour: A drowned harpooner who never let go of the line. It still throws.

stormglass_warden.name: Stormglass Warden
stormglass_warden.flavour: Lightning that struck the same sand twice and cooled into a sentry.

cinder_colossus.name: Cinder Colossus
cinder_colossus.flavour: A forge-heap the Herald taught to walk. Each step leaves a glowing print.

herald_zealot.name: Herald's Zealot
herald_zealot.flavour: Sworn to the throne beyond the march, and patient with a crossbow.

umbral_harbinger.name: Umbral Harbinger
umbral_harbinger.flavour: The first shadow the Deep sends up. Where it stands, the light thins.
